records.meta: TV series · ABC · USA · English · S05E09 'The Horizon' (aired 13 Dec 2005) · TV-14

records.summary: Pregnant CIA agent Sydney Bristow is abducted by Prophet Five (Desantis) and put under hypnosis so she will reveal what Vaughn told her about 'The Horizon'. She realises what is happening and resists by giving a false name. When she wakes she is on a ship and learns her captor is interested in her unborn baby.
